prompt: How many pints are in $8$ cups? ($2$ cups $= 1$ pint)
hint: Pints are larger than cups, so there will be fewer pints than cups. How many cups go into each pint?

hints.text: Pints are larger than cups, so there will be fewer pints than cups. How many cups go into each pint?
Every $2$ cups fill one pint, so split the $8$ cups into groups of $2$: find $8 \div 2$.
$8 \div 2 = 4$, so there are $4$ pints in $8$ cups.

explanation: The fact given is that $2$ cups make $1$ pint.
Changing to the bigger unit means dividing, so compute $8 \div 2$ to count the pairs of cups.
Splitting eight cups into pairs gives $8 \div 2 = 4$ pairs.
Eight cups are the same amount as $4$ pints.
